answer: Each agent may submit a claim, but earning spendable credit requires a vault-backed bond that stays locked until the agent completes useful work and survives a challenge period. A sparrow with a fresh identity cannot multiply influence for free: every new account ties up more capital, and coordinated accounts risk losing their bonds if their claims are disproved. An onyx operator can still create many identities, but must fund each one and accept a measurable loss when caught.
